set.body:
Outcome: replace the current full-volume coordinate-search default with a reusable, typed, production-grade rigid estimator informed by Volregger's successful experiments but corrected for complete Grid geometry and SE(3) semantics. Coordinate search remains only as an explicit reference or fallback strategy.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-420-01: Public optimizer configuration is expressed through validated typed policies for sampling, robust loss, damping, capture, convergence, and execution; it does not expose a stringly Volregger-style option bag.
AC-420-02: Compilation produces immutable, shareable fixed-domain state containing all reusable gradient, stencil, scale, and geometry data; each run uses an explicit non-shareable workspace.
AC-420-03: The hot kernel deterministically accumulates a six-parameter robust normal system without per-sample or per-voxel object allocation and uses each moving and fixed Grid's complete index-to-frame affine.
AC-420-04: Pose increments are derived and applied through the authoritative frame-directed SE(3) retraction. Transform polarity and update side are executable laws, not comments or Euler compatibility conventions.
AC-420-05: Damping, rejected steps, singular or ill-conditioned systems, insufficient overlap, iteration limits, and stationary convergence have distinct typed outcomes. A candidate cannot improve by discarding difficult voxels.
AC-420-06: Capture seeding, multiscale continuation, temporal warm starts, and template fitting consume the same pair-optimizer contract without duplicating sampling or pose algebra.
AC-420-07: Ordinary objective evaluation and final application continue to use production reframe4s resampling. No spacing-only coordinate map or private competing interpolation kernel is introduced.
AC-420-08: mig-414 passes its independent analytic, metamorphic, adversarial, JVM/Scala.js, determinism, allocation, peak-memory, and throughput gates with the new optimizer. The truth-pose objective is measured explicitly before any recovery tolerance is changed.
AC-420-09: Foundation documentation identifies the default production strategy, the reference/fallback strategy, numerical assumptions, unsupported cases, and the evidence revision.
set.title: EPIC: Build the production-grade compiled rigid optimizer
